metadata.description: Marketplace hosting the Frontend Kit plugin for Claude Code — project-aware frontend engineering with enforced quality rules.

plugins.name: frontend-kit
plugins.description: Project-aware frontend engineering kit. Figma-to-Code and Lift-and-Shift onboarding with enforced setup gates; requirement analysis; pixel-perfect responsive implementation; five write rules enforced by hooks (component reuse, breakpoint coverage, accessibility, dark-mode pairing, duplicate dependencies); forms, async states, SEO, TypeScript, i18n/RTL, Storybook and unit-test workflows; browser verification and visual-regression diffing; plus a self-learning loop that records its own mistakes to project memory.
